name: Rokudemonepic
source:
A story about us, the fakes, the stand-ins, the imposters.

Jill, a worthless supporting character killed by the hero at the end of the story.

But he awakens again.

His savior is a mysterious girl who forces him to play brother and sister!

Next to her is a suspicious butler who only tells lies!

A reunion with the hero who killed him!

That's the kind of fake brother-sister romantic comedy fantasy it is.
